dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - APM - Trace Diagnostics
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for trace count, slow traces, error traces, database spans, outbound spans, and log correlation. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Trace diagnostics
pages.description: Trace-level diagnosis for slow and failing backend requests.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(traceId) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), max(duration), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET traceId, name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), latest(error.class), latest(name) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND error IS true FACET traceId LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND db.system = 'postgresql' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), latest(request.id), latest(message.safe) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND trace.id IS NOT NULL FACET trace.id LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET category, name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: If spans are absent, run backend_newrelic_observability_check.py --enforce and verify PHP distributed tracing plus request traffic.
